name: Momose Kaguya
source:
A Holland Lop beastfolk who is timid and shy girl. She likes to be pampered,
and will cling tightly to people they trust and be very affectionate like a rabbit. When her older sister became the manager of Mochizuki's second branch, she came to Yunagicho Town in order to help her beloved sister. However, she's not good with men, so she's not very good at serving customers. After the protagonist helped her, she started calling him "Onii-chan" and admiring him.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1125252]Getchu[/url]]
